verdict.rationale: Marlin's own docs say it automatically produces a fully referenced report, with appendices and references, plus PowerPoint slides. That covers the document and presentation part of the story. Nothing in the evidence mentions spreadsheet output, reference-manager files (such as BibTeX or RIS), or a user-selectable export menu. Missing for 10: spreadsheet export, reference-manager file export, documented choice of export formats, independent hands-on confirmation of output file formats.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files

citations.quote: From a fully referenced report to PowerPoint slides, everything is automatically generated
Everything from the main body to appendices, references, and presentation slides is automatically generated
Marlin carries the research through to completion and delivers both summary slides and a detailed report.
